landing.hero_subtitle: Stop fighting with context limits and hallucinating models. Securely isolate tenant data, deploy agentic pipelines, and monitor real-time AI usage with our unified B2B platform.
landing.features_title: Built for scale, designed for security.
landing.features_subtitle: Everything you need to launch enterprise AI assistants.
landing.feat_1_desc: Cryptographically separate vector spaces for every client. Zero cross-contamination.
landing.feat_2_desc: Semantic routers dynamically select the best LLM and embedding pipeline per query.
landing.feat_3_desc: Granular permissions for Super Admins, Tenant Admins, and standard end-users.
landing.feat_4_desc: Real-time telemetry and monitoring for LLM token usage and response latency.
landing.faq_1_a: We use dedicated Qdrant collections and strict row-level security in PostgreSQL to ensure tenant data is physically and logically separated.
landing.faq_2_q: Can I bring my own LLM?
landing.faq_2_a: Yes. Enterprise plans support custom endpoint routing to your own private OpenAI, Anthropic, or local open-source models.
landing.faq_3_a: Instead of a simple vector search, our agents use tool-calling to re-rank, summarize, and cross-reference multiple documents before answering.
landing.cta_subtitle: Execute RAG tests in parallel across massive document sets with a reliable isolated infrastructure.
